description.en: Google Antigravity provider with v1internal envelope code carried by the plugin.
description.zh: 插件自带 Google v1internal 包装代码的 Antigravity Provider。

help.en: Which Google Code Assist host this plugin talks to. Applies to every Antigravity account after you save. Sign-in itself always uses Google OAuth and does not change.
help.zh: 本插件请求的 Google Code Assist 环境。保存后对所有 Antigravity 账号生效。登录仍走 Google OAuth，不受此项影响。
